product_title: Handcrafted Pink Lotus Peacock Feather Tealight Holder Set
product_description: Enhance your festive decor with this handcrafted tealight holder set, featuring vibrant pink lotus motifs, peacock feather-inspired accents, golden detailing, and elegant pearl embellishments. Perfect for Diwali, pooja rooms, and festive table styling.
product_care_suggestion: Clean gently with a soft, dry cloth.
Keep away from water and harsh chemicals.
Protect decorative embellishments from excessive heat.
Place on a stable, heat-resistant surface when using tealights.
Store in a dry, protective box when not in use.
